parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules mentioned in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by document CHEMBL1123860. Join compound_structures on molregno and require canonical_smiles to be present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
